headword: {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}

definitions.explanation: The second of the two main divisions of the Christian Bible, recounting the life and teachings of Jesus, the early Christian church, and the letters of the apostles. The Japanese name literally means 'the scripture of the new covenant,' the covenant that Christians believe God established through Jesus.

examples.japanese: {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}はギリシャ{語|ご}で{書|か}かれた。
examples.english: The New Testament was written in Greek.

examples.japanese: {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{福音書|ふくいんしょ}はイエスの{生涯|しょうがい}を{伝|つた}えている。
examples.english: The Gospels of the New Testament convey the life of Jesus.

examples.japanese: {日曜日|にちようび}の{礼拝|れいはい}で{新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{一節|いっせつ}が{朗読|ろうどく}された。
examples.english: A passage from the New Testament was read aloud at the Sunday service.

examples.japanese: {西洋文学|せいようぶんがく}を{理解|りかい}するには、{新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{背景知識|はいけいちしき}がある{程度|ていど}{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To really understand Western literature, you need a certain amount of background knowledge about the New Testament.

notes:
Compound of {新約|しんやく} ('new covenant') and {聖書|せいしょ} ('scripture; Bible'). The term reflects the Christian view that Jesus established a 'new covenant' fulfilling and renewing the older one described in the {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}を{読|よ}む: to read the New Testament
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: the Gospels (in the New Testament)
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{教|おし}え: the teachings of the New Testament
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{一節|いっせつ}: a passage from the New Testament
- {新約聖書|しんやくせいしょ}の{原文|げんぶん}: the original text of the New Testament

WELL-KNOWN BOOKS:
- マタイによる{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: Gospel of Matthew
- マルコによる{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: Gospel of Mark
- ルカによる{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: Gospel of Luke
- ヨハネによる{福音書|ふくいんしょ}: Gospel of John
- {使徒|しと}{言行録|げんこうろく}: Acts of the Apostles
- ヨハネの{黙示録|もくしろく}: Book of Revelation

USAGE:
- A standard term in religious, historical, and literary discourse. Often paired with {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ} when discussing the Bible as a whole.
- Commonly abbreviated to {新約|しんやく} when context is clear, e.g., {新約|しんやく}の{時代|じだい} ('the New Testament era').
- In Japan, many proper names and cultural allusions derived from the New Testament — such as {最後|さいご}の{晩餐|ばんさん} ('Last Supper') or {復活|ふっかつ} ('resurrection') — appear regularly in art, novels, and films.

RELATED WORDS:
- {旧約聖書|きゅうやくせいしょ}: Old Testament
- {聖書|せいしょ}: Bible; scripture
- {福音書|ふくいんしょ}: the Gospels
- キリスト{教|きょう}: Christianity
- {聖典|せいてん}: sacred text; scripture
